column2: Now that the Holy Roman Empire has been properly decentralised, it is time to expand our influence all over Europa by creating new german Imperial Realms.
This realm is rich and should be raided for their wealth.
As the King of England, we have a right to the Kingdom of France and we will take our rightfull claim by force.
As one of the successors of the Diadochi, we have the right to reclaim the lands of Alexander the Great.
Our realm is getting weaker in France while our Appanages are breaking free. We have to resubjugate them back into our fold.
Our realm needs to grow, not by land but by Appanges. the more Appanges we hold the stronger we are.
As we have given our Appanages more power, it is time to expand the realm of France by setting up lesser French realms that are under our autonomous control.
Our lands are poor and we need better land to live in, perhaps it would not be a bad idea to migrate to other lands from this realm.
Those Romans think they own the world and we need to put them on their place, it is time to take their lands and reduce their power.
As the Franks, our hate towards the Roman Empire has never ended and we need to get our vengance. Especially now since they are at their weakest.
The Sciris have been ruling Italia long enough, we have the right to beat our rivals and take the rich lands of Italia for us.
We will §Yimmediately§! declare war on the Byzantines to make them our Tributary
